subject: Tri-region demo — proposal for rotational schedule during DST mismatch
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@brightbank.com>
To: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@brightbank.com, josh.lee@brightbank.com
Date: Sun, 9 Mar 2025 18:12:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Tri-region demo — trying to lock in next week

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for the follow up. We're excited to see Redwood in action. Our original ask was for a single 60-minute session that covers core flows for Product, SecOps, and Platform. Because we span EMEA and APAC teams, we'd prefer something that doesn't force late nights.

Quick note: our EMEA office moves to DST on 30 Mar; I noticed the US shift on 9 Mar means your home region will already be on DST. That creates a short window where relative offsets are different and makes a single global time awkward for some of our engineers in Singapore.

Would it help if we did two back-to-back 30-minute segments (APAC-first, then EMEA/US)? Or if Redwood prefers a single session, any chance you can propose a rotation plan so we hand off between regional hosts?

Attached: time-conversion-chart.xlsx (shows local times for the mismatch week).

Best,
Marta
Senior Product Manager, BrightBank

Attachment: time-conversion-chart.xlsx (spreadsheet list of zones and offsets)

From: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@brightbank.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 10 Mar 2025 09:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Tri-region demo — proposal for rotational schedule during DST mismatch

Hi Marta — thanks for the context and the conversion sheet. Totally agree we should avoid making anyone stay up after midnight.

Proposal (quick):
- Break the session into two focused 30-minute blocks on the same calendar event. APAC-focused segment (00:00–00:30 UTC+8 content) followed by a handoff to EU/US-focused segment (00:30–01:00 UTC+1/UTC-7 content).
- Redwood will provide two hosts: Marcus (APAC-friendly hours) to lead the first half, then Laura to continue for EMEA/US. I'll stay on the call for transitions and Q&A.
- We'll keep Q&A constrained to the second 15 minutes of each block and capture any longer asks as follow-up actions.

Concretely for the mismatch week (US already on DST, EU not yet): here are the suggested wall-clock times — choose the row that fits the majority.
- Option A (earlier): 04:00 SGT / 20:00 CET (previous day) / 11:00 PDT
- Option B (later): 06:00 SGT / 22:00 CET (previous day) / 13:00 PDT

I attached a one-page rotation plan (redwood-demo-rotation-proposal.pdf) and an .ics you can import that creates two consecutive 30-minute segments in one invite. If that looks good, we can set the invite and assign hosts.

Next step: which option do you prefer (A or B)? If neither, tell us the worst time window and we will rework.

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-demo-rotation-proposal.pdf, proposed-rotation.ics

From: Josh Lee <josh.lee@brightbank.com>
To: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@brightbank.com>
Cc: ops@brightbank.com
Date: Mon, 10 Mar 2025 11:22:00 +08:00
Subject: Re: Tri-region demo — proposal for rotational schedule during DST mismatch

Thanks Vivek — appreciate the concrete options.

Quick internal check: Option A (earlier) pushes our Singapore engineers to a late night but keeps Platform and SecOps in Europe at a reasonable time (20:00). Option B is better for the APAC folks but may be during our PM team’s busy window.

I think we can do Option A if you can guarantee a tight agenda and a recording for folks who can't join live. Also, can we confirm the recording will be stored behind our SSO link and a copy pushed to our Ops mailbox?

I'll confirm with the APAC leads by EOD and circle back.

Josh
Technical Program Manager, BrightBank

(On a separate note: HubSpot deal BRI-7421 is updated with demo milestone.)

Thanks Josh & Marta — glad Option A is workable.

We will:
- Lock Option A: 04:00 SGT / 20:00 CET (previous day) / 11:00 PDT on March 18, 2025 (this is during the US DST week where offsets are shifted).
- Agenda (30 + 30):
  * 00:00–00:30 SGT: APAC flows, data residency notes, integration hooks (Marcus lead)
  * 00:30–01:00 SGT: EMEA/US flows, routing/fallback discussion, cost/latency Q&A (Laura lead)
- Recording: we'll record, store behind our SSO and share a link restricted to your ops@brightbank.com address. We'll push an archive to your ops mailbox.
- Action items: Marcus will run the APAC demo script; Laura will own the second half. Vivek will manage handoff and notes. Marissa will take follow-up tickets and own the mutual action plan.

I attached the final rotation PDF and a calendar invite. Please accept the invite (proposed-rotation.ics) so the two-block structure is visible. If anything needs changing — time, attendees, or add a recording requirement — reply here and we'll update.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
